_comment: LXM-REQ-000239: the tooling names no agent, tool, person or host; those live in the registries. agnostic.py takes every label and alias the registries list and fails when one appears in the tooling's code or configuration outside them. An exemption needs a reason.

exempt.code_adapter.json: names the repository's own CI workflow file (commands.ci_workflows), a path the repository chose; the host registry records the same path as that host's ci_workflow
exempt.code_baseline.json: generated record of the code findings at the candidate; it quotes, word for word, the names the findings report
exempt.config_baseline.json: generated record of the configuration findings at the candidate; it quotes the values the findings report
